governing_principle: Listener gate thresholds remain uncalibrated pending frozen model representations. Composer generalization gate is a Listener-only property evaluating performance degradation on composer-disjoint human repertoire.

PREDICTIVE_GATE.metric: Negative log-likelihood perplexity / bit-rate on held-out human corpus segments
PREDICTIVE_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: Perplexity improvement over empirical unigram and first-order Markov baselines
PREDICTIVE_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Stage-0 Artificial Listener representation model trained on development cohort

INVARIANCE_GATE.metric: Cosine similarity of representations under identity-preserving transformations T_ID
INVARIANCE_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: Median cosine similarity >= tau_identity prospective calibration via Youden's J on development folds
INVARIANCE_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Frozen Listener encoder representation evaluated on transformation registry T_ID

DISCRIMINATION_GATE.metric: Negative-foil similarity separation (cosine distance margin or AUROC) against matched foils
DISCRIMINATION_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: AUROC >= tau_auroc and foil cosine similarity <= tau_foil
DISCRIMINATION_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Frozen Listener encoder representation evaluated on matched negative-foil pool

COUNTERFACTUAL_GATE.metric: Directional contrast response (ClosureContrast, SurpriseContrast) vs matched neutral controls
COUNTERFACTUAL_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: Statistically significant directional separation: lower 95% percentile bootstrap CI > 0
COUNTERFACTUAL_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Counterfactual perturbations CF-CLOSURE and CF-SURPRISE applied to frozen Listener

SOURCE_SEGMENT_STRUCTURAL_MEMORY_GATE.metric: Source-segment recurrence retrieval similarity m_A(t) = sim(z(A), h_t) across intervening context and MemoryContrast vs matched control
SOURCE_SEGMENT_STRUCTURAL_MEMORY_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: MemoryContrast > 0 with lower 95% percentile bootstrap CI > 0 and separation over matched unrelated-segment foil
SOURCE_SEGMENT_STRUCTURAL_MEMORY_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Frozen Listener state dynamics evaluated on multi-section development pieces with literal and transformed source-segment recurrences

ANTI_COPY_GATE.metric: Three-tier anti-copy metric: symbolic n-gram overlap, information-weighted interval n-gram with ADD_ALPHA smoothing, nearest-neighbor latent retrieval
ANTI_COPY_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: Max contiguous match <= tau_copy_ngram and latent nearest-neighbor distance >= tau_copy_latent
ANTI_COPY_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Corpus development n-gram language models with ADD_ALPHA estimator and frozen representation lookup index

COMPOSER_GENERALIZATION_GATE.metric: Performance degradation of a frozen Listener on composer-disjoint human-composed repertoire relative to development composer distribution
COMPOSER_GENERALIZATION_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: Relative degradation <= tau_generalization on held-out human composer disjoint partitions without involving generated repertoire
COMPOSER_GENERALIZATION_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Sufficient verified composer-disjoint physical corpus coverage (Stage-1 Composer generation is NOT a prerequisite)

SOURCE_SEGMENT_INVARIANCE.metric: Representation cosine similarity under algorithmic identity-preserving transformations T_ID_1..7 applied to physical score segments
SOURCE_SEGMENT_INVARIANCE.provisional_threshold_description: Optimal operational threshold tau_identity prospective calibration via Youden's J on development folds
SOURCE_SEGMENT_INVARIANCE.calibration_prerequisite: Frozen representation embeddings of development segments and their T_ID transforms

THEME_MOTIF_IDENTITY.metric: Cross-variation and development-section thematic motif embedding concordance
THEME_MOTIF_IDENTITY.provisional_threshold_description: Unassigned pending verified human thematic motif annotations (Route A) or explicit recurrence metadata (Route B)
THEME_MOTIF_IDENTITY.calibration_prerequisite: Independently adjudicated annotations (Route A) or lineage-valid explicit recurrence-family metadata (Route B)

THEMATIC_MEMORY_GATE.metric: Thematic motif memory reactivation and developmental variation tracing
THEMATIC_MEMORY_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: Unassigned pending operational theme motif identity; does not block PF-002A source-segment structural memory
THEMATIC_MEMORY_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: THEME_MOTIF_IDENTITY operational status achieved via Route A or Route B
